statement.zh: 教科文名录715将拉帕努伊国家公园列为世界遗产；本档案仅用外链、不托管摩艾影像。
statement.en: UNESCO list 715 designates Rapa Nui National Park as World Heritage; this archive uses outbound links only and does not host moai imagery.
